g.text: FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (64-Round) Nonce Scaling: k = 1..32 Unknown Bits
Single-core wall-clock T(k) on AMD Ryzen 9 5950X (core 12, Tₘₐₓ = 300 s, W₀ = 0x9E3779B9, 272/272 SAT verified) · 5 engines (7 tracks)
Unknown Nonce Bits k (LSB prefix of W₀ = 0x9E3779B9)

• Lifting k≤24 cap solves k=32 in 7.7–10.1m
